context_requirements: Expression of functional PRKAA1/PRKAA2 catalytic subunits and STK11/LKB1 or CAMKK2 upstream activation
Intact AMPK heterotrimer signaling to downstream substrates (ACC, TSC2, RAPTOR, ULK1)
Metabolic stress or high energy demand that allows AMPK activation to alter transcription
For antiproliferative/autophagic effects, intact autophagy machinery (ATG7) and apoptosis resistance may enhance response
falsifiers: No change in canonical AMPK transcriptional targets (DDIT4, SESN1, TRIB3, SQSTM1, BNIP3) at 6 h or 24 h in any responsive line
No suppression of sterol/lipid synthesis genes (HMGCR, HMGCS1, FDFT1, INSIG1) at 24 h
No G1 arrest or proliferation_down signature at 24 h despite AMPK activation
Strong interferon or heat-shock response without AMPK target induction, suggesting off-target effects
Line responses completely uncorrelated with known AMPK pathway status (e.g., no response in LKB1-mutant lines but strong response in LKB1-intact lines)

evidence.supports: Small molecule AMPK activator A-769662 protects heart via AMPK-dependent mechanism, confirming direct AMPK activation is achievable pharmacologically
Hernandezine directly activates AMPK and induces autophagic cell death in drug-resistant cancer lines including A549, MCF-7, PC3, HepG2
AICAR, an AMPK activator, inhibits palmitate-induced apoptosis in osteoblasts via AMPK-dependent pathway
AICAR protects against cisplatin-induced acute kidney injury through AMPK and JAK/STAT/SOCS signaling
AICAR reduces IL-6 and IL-8 expression in human adipose tissue and skeletal muscle cells, indicating anti-inflammatory transcriptional effects

changes: Removed CXCL2, EGR1, FOS, JUN, ZFP36, TSC22D3 from proximal_up: these are generic immediate-early/stress/inflammatory genes not established as direct AMPK transcriptional targets; their direction is not justified by the cited AMPK-activator evidence.
Kept canonical AMPK targets DDIT4, SESN1, TRIB3, SQSTM1, BNIP3, BNIP3L, PPARD, NFE2L2, HMOX1 in proximal_up as directionally consistent with AMPK activation.
Kept HMGCR, HMGCS1, FDFT1, INSIG1, ACLY in proximal_down as AMPK suppresses sterol/lipid synthesis; no gene appears in both up and down lists at the same time.

No changes to late_up/late_down, generic_effects, kinetics, magnitude, line_response, context_requirements, falsifiers, or evidence because no item-by-item contradiction was identified from the provided abstracts.
